overall: The AG found the Board failed to fully comply: a notice naming a proposed industrial complex without an address or landmark lacked sufficient specificity. Resolved with guidance only; the AG declined to rescind the Board's action.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the August 24, 2010 notice listing a 'Proposed Holbrook Industrial Development Complex' did not define the location or address of the proposed complex.

remedy: In the future, the Board of Selectmen is required to comply with the Open Meeting Law, G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25, and is advised to provide sufficient detail in meeting notices so that members of the public know with specificity what issues and locations will be discussed by the Board.
remedy_passage: In the future, the Board of Selectmen is required to comply with the Open Meeting Law, G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25, and is advised to provide sufficient detail in meeting notices so that members of the public know with specificity what issues and locations will be discussed by the Board.
